## TRA Timeline

#### SPAC business combination and TRA execution

- 2021-05-27: DEFM14A attaches form-of TRA as Annex G
- 2021-06-24: FinTech IV / PWP business combination closes with Up-C structure; executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.2 to the 8-K of June 30, 2021

#### Continuing liability accrual

- 2025-12-31: Liability stands at $93.5M (up from $14.1M at 12/31/2021), reflecting accumulated Class A Unit exchanges and Section 754 step-up amortization

## Explanation

Perella Weinberg Partners became the TRA obligor on June 24, 2021 at the closing of its SPAC combination with FinTech Acquisition Corp. IV, producing an Up-C structure with PWP Holdings LP as the operating partnership and the Investor Limited Partners and Partners of PWP Professional Partners LP as TRA beneficiaries. The TRA pays beneficiaries 85% of the cash tax savings PWP realizes from the de-SPAC transactions, Section 754 basis step-ups arising from future exchanges of PWP OpCo Class A Units for Class A common stock, and TRA-imputed interest. No amendment, restatement, or termination instrument has been filed. The recorded liability has grown from $14.1M at year-end 2021 to $93.5M at year-end 2025 as additional Class A Unit exchanges have generated incremental step-ups, which is expected behavior for an in-force Up-C TRA. Several Limited Partnership Agreement amendments and internal-reorganization filings appear in the record but none amend the TRA itself. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
